 Philadelphia 76ers 41 – 48 Live Cleveland Cavaliers Live Updated a few seconds ago 76ers vs Cavaliers LIVE, Score Updates after Q1 and Stats in NBA Cup (41-48)
 Follow Philadelphia 76ers vs Cleveland Cavaliers live score updates, starting lineups, box score stats and play-by-play on Prime Video in 2026 Emirates NBA Cup Group Play.
 Coverage by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta Updated November 6, 2026, 8:29 pm ET ADVERTISEMENT
 Live Last update 8:29 PM ET 8:25 PM ET 5 minutes ago 2Q | 7:03: VJ Edgecombe hits 24-foot triple as 76ers cut Cavaliers lead to 48-39
 Jaylen Brown hit a 12-foot jumper off a LeBron James assist at 8:09, and VJ Edgecombe added a 13-foot basket at 7:38 after a Jabari Walker defensive rebound. Mario Hezonja answered with a driving layup from Meleek Thomas at 7:19 before Edgecombe buried a 24-foot three-pointer assisted by James at 7:05, giving Edgecombe 12 points on 5-of-6 shooting as the Cleveland Cavaliers lead the Philadelphia 76ers 48-39 at the 7:03 mark.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 Key moments
 6:47 PM ET Inside Rocket Arena in Cleveland ahead of 7:30… 
 Follow VAVEL on Google 8:19 PM ET 10 minutes ago 2Q | 10:13: Tyrese Proctor completes 3-point play as Cavaliers lead 76ers 38-25
 Evan Mobley threw down a dunk off a Mario Hezonja assist at 11:17 before VJ Edgecombe answered with a 23-foot three-pointer from Anfernee Simons at 11:01. Tyrese Proctor then scored a two-foot basket through a Simons shooting foul and hit the free throw at 10:48, pushing the Cleveland Cavaliers' lead to 38-25 over the Philadelphia 76ers with 10:13 left in the second quarter.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 8:13 PM ET 17 minutes ago End of 1Q: Cleveland Cavaliers take a 33-22 lead over Philadelphia 76ers
 The Cleveland Cavaliers close the first quarter with a 33-22 lead over the Philadelphia 76ers after Jabari Walker went to the free-throw line at the 21.4-second mark and Kentavious Caldwell-Pope checked in for Tyrese Maxey. On the final possession of the period, Donovan Mitchell missed a 24-foot pull-up three-pointer with 4.5 seconds left, and Tyrese Proctor grabbed the offensive rebound before missing a 24-foot three-pointer at the horn.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 8:12 PM ET 17 minutes ago 1Q | 21.4: Donovan Mitchell reaches 10 points as Cavaliers lead 76ers 33-21
 Donovan Mitchell sank two free throws and scored inside to reach 10 points on 4-of-7 shooting with 3 assists, while Thomas Bryant added a putback to give the Cleveland Cavaliers a 33-21 lead over the Philadelphia 76ers with 21.4 seconds left in the first quarter. Jaylen Brown hit a jumper for Philadelphia alongside 6 points from Tyrese Maxey, before Jabari Walker grabbed an offensive rebound at 23.4 seconds and Bryant committed a shooting foul.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 8:06 PM ET 23 minutes ago 1Q | 2:21: Meleek Thomas and Thomas Bryant push Cavaliers lead to 27-12
 Meleek Thomas hit a 25-foot running jumper at 3:34 and a 26-foot three-pointer at 2:57 off Donovan Mitchell assists, answering a 29-foot triple from Anfernee Simons at 3:16. After Thomas grabbed the defensive rebound on a missed floating jumper by Tyrese Maxey at 2:38, Mitchell fed Thomas Bryant for a running dunk at 2:32 to give the Cleveland Cavaliers a 27-12 lead over the Philadelphia 76ers with 2:21 left in the first quarter.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 8:01 PM ET 28 minutes ago 1Q | 4:27: Tyrese Maxey drains step-back three as 76ers cut Cavaliers lead to 19-9
 Tyrese Maxey buried a 25-foot step-back three-pointer off an assist from LeBron James with 4:27 left in the first quarter, trimming the Cleveland Cavaliers' lead over the Philadelphia 76ers to 19-9. The basket followed a LeBron James defensive rebound after consecutive misses by Tyrese Proctor, Evan Mobley, and Mario Hezonja. Donovan Mitchell leads Cleveland with 6 points on 3-of-4 shooting, while Joel Embiid also knocked down a pair of free throws for Philadelphia.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 7:55 PM ET 35 minutes ago 1Q | 6:03: Evan Mobley hits from deep as Cavaliers extend lead to 17-4
 Evan Mobley connected on a 25-foot three-pointer off an assist from James Harden at the 7:27 mark after Sam Merrill forced a Joel Embiid turnover, stretching the Cleveland Cavaliers' lead over the Philadelphia 76ers to 17-4 with 6:03 remaining in the first quarter. Donovan Mitchell added a steal on a Jaylen Brown turnover at 7:18 and leads Cleveland with 6 points on 3-of-4 shooting. LeBron James pulled down a defensive rebound at 6:53 and answered with a layup at 6:37 for Philadelphia.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 7:50 PM ET 39 minutes ago 1Q | 7:55: Donovan Mitchell paces Cavaliers to an early 11-2 lead over 76ers
 The Cleveland Cavaliers hold an 11-2 lead over the Philadelphia 76ers with 7:55 remaining in the first quarter behind 6 points on 3-of-4 shooting and 1 rebound from Donovan Mitchell. After Peyton Watson and Joel Embiid traded missed three-point jumpers at 8:20 and 8:10, James Harden converted the first of two free throws at 7:55 following a shooting foul on Jaylen Brown, while VJ Edgecombe has 2 points for Philadelphia.
